name: ski
pixel_processing: Exact half-scale premultiplied-alpha Lanczos; transparent trim; original bitmap sharing; no generated artwork.
playback_timing: Frame duration records original preview seconds (0.03). Playback weight records Godot relative duration (1.0). Animation fps and duration describe the SpriteFrames resource. In battle, air playback is scaled to the jump duration. Land stays at 0.30s and other clips retain source preview speed.
foot_point_method: Per-action fixed first-frame ski-ground anchor; excludes pole tips and snow wake. Air uses the lower ski edge. No original PAM pivots are supplied; no per-frame translation removal.

integration.notes: Anchors/collision are integration suggestions measured in half-size output pixels. Flight arc belongs to game logic. Rush Up/Fall Down were excluded because their source frames contain substantial translation.

damage_art.note: Selected death keeps the head and skis; do not overlay an extra detached head. No assembled damaged walking/eating states are provided.

audio_reuse.purpose: Existing project takeoff sound; not a claimed original Ski-specific sound.
